newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CIBA Vision concentrates Swiss business.
newsitem.headline: CIBA Vision concentrates Swiss business.

text.p: CIBA Vision, a unit of Novartis, will transfer its optics business unit from Niederwangen, near Berne, to Buelach, near Zurich, where it will be integrated with Ciba Vision's ophthalmics operation, Novartis said.
The move will be completed by January 1998 and affect 18 full-time and two part-time employees in Niederwangen. In Buehlach 15 new jobs will be created.
The merger will strengthen its competitiveness of Ciba Vision in Switzerland by making better use of synergies and avoid duplication of administrative work, Novartis said in a statement.
